mostWorthwhile.text: Processing the water was most worthwhile: it connected the extraction to a usable drinking supply and explained the treatment and checks.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hose was straightforward, though the strainer detail gave it some purpose.

surprise.text: I did not expect the extraction probe to warm the ice and produce a cloudy trickle directly.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary, though each step had only one offered combination, leaving little room for decisions.

continue.text: I would continue for the practical explanations and the prospect of seeing the expedition develop, although I would hope for more meaningful choices.
